title: pelican-panel chart values
description: Values of the pelican-panel Helm chart, which deploys the unmodified upstream Pelican Panel image (Caddy, PHP-FPM, the queue worker and the scheduler in one container) with optional bundled MariaDB and Redis. Helm validates the merged values (values.yaml, every -f file and every --set) against this schema on install, upgrade, template and lint, before any template renders. Every value is also documented in README.md.
$comment: Draft-07 keeps the schema readable by every Helm 3 release (Helm < 3.18 only understands draft-04 to draft-07). Objects the chart models key by key set additionalProperties: false so a misspelt key fails instead of being ignored silently. Cross-field rules (replicaCount > 1, https without a proxy, a redis driver without a host, trustedProxies '*') stay in the `pelican-panel.validate` template helper, whose messages explain the fix. Keep this file in step with values.yaml and the templates.

global.$comment: Helm injects an empty `global` map into the values of every chart; allow it so additionalProperties: false at the root does not reject it.
global.description: Helm's global values. Unused by this chart.

replicaCount.description: Panel replicas. Keep 1: the image also runs the Laravel scheduler and keeps cache and session files on local disk. More than 1 needs panel.skipMigrations true and neither panel.cacheStore nor panel.sessionDriver set to file (the chart refuses other combinations), plus a ReadWriteMany volume or no persistence.

tag.description: Image tag. Empty uses the chart's appVersion.

imagePullSecrets.description: imagePullSecrets of the Panel, MariaDB and Redis pods, as LocalObjectReferences (`- name: <secret>`).

nameOverride.description: Replaces the chart name in resource names and the app.kubernetes.io/name label.

fullnameOverride.description: Replaces the full `<release>-<chart>` prefix of resource names. Truncated to 63 characters.

commonLabels.description: Labels added to every rendered object.

commonAnnotations.description: Annotations added to every rendered object.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount. With false, `name` (or the namespace's `default`) is used as is.

name.description: Name of the ServiceAccount. Empty uses the full release name when create is true and `default` otherwise.

annotations.description: Annotations of the ServiceAccount (workload identity bindings).

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token. The Panel never calls the Kubernetes API.

panel.description: Panel configuration. Each key maps to an environment variable the upstream image or Laravel reads; non-secret ones go into a ConfigMap, secret ones into a Secret.

appName.description: `APP_NAME`: branding shown in the UI and in mails.

url.description: `APP_URL`: the externally reachable URL, scheme included, without a trailing slash. Generated links, assets and the Filament login break when it does not match what browsers use.

env.description: `APP_ENV`. Use production for anything reachable by users.

debug.description: `APP_DEBUG`: show stack traces in the browser. Never enable in production; traces leak configuration.

locale.description: `APP_LOCALE`: default UI language, as a language code with an optional region (`en`, `de`, `pt_BR`).

installed.description: `APP_INSTALLED`. true makes the entrypoint wait for the database and run `php artisan migrate --force` on every start (the chart-managed, non-interactive install). false serves the web installer instead.

skipMigrations.description: `SKIP_MIGRATIONS`: skip migrations on start. Required when replicaCount is above 1, so only one process migrates.

behindProxy.description: `BEHIND_PROXY`: Caddy listens on plain :80 with automatic HTTPS off. Required behind an Ingress controller or the OpenShift router.

trustedProxies.description: `TRUSTED_PROXIES`: comma-separated IPs or CIDRs whose X-Forwarded-* headers Laravel and Caddy honour. Without it the Filament login redirects to http and every request logs the proxy's IP. `*` and `**` break the bundled Caddy (allowed only with skipCaddy); `0.0.0.0/0,::/0` is the working equivalent. Empty trusts no proxy.

leEmail.description: `LE_EMAIL`: Let's Encrypt account email. Used only when the bundled Caddy terminates TLS itself (behindProxy false and an https url), and required then.

skipCaddy.description: `SKIP_CADDY`: run PHP-FPM only and expose FastCGI on port 9000 instead of HTTP on 80, for an external FastCGI-capable web server. Disables the probes.

cacheStore.description: `CACHE_STORE`. `database` is not offered: the Panel ships no `cache` table migration. redis needs redis.enabled or externalRedis.host.

sessionDriver.description: `SESSION_DRIVER`. database keeps users logged in across pod restarts. redis needs redis.enabled or externalRedis.host.

queueConnection.description: `QUEUE_CONNECTION`. sync runs jobs inside the web request. redis needs redis.enabled or externalRedis.host.

twoFactorRequired.description: `APP_2FA_REQUIRED`: 0 optional, 1 required for admins, 2 required for everyone. Empty leaves it to the Panel setting.

timezone.description: `TZ` of the container (logs, cron). The Panel itself always runs on UTC; users pick a display timezone in their profile.

mailer.description: `MAIL_MAILER`: the Laravel mail transport. log writes mails to the log, array discards them.

host.description: `MAIL_HOST`: SMTP server. Empty leaves it unset.

port.description: `MAIL_PORT`: SMTP port (25, 465, 587). Empty leaves it unset.

password.description: `MAIL_PASSWORD`, stored in the chart-managed Secret. Ignored when panel.existingSecret is set; use existingSecretMailPasswordKey then.

scheme.description: `MAIL_SCHEME`: smtps for implicit TLS (port 465), smtp for plain or STARTTLS. Empty leaves it unset.

extraEnv.description: Extra plain environment variables, rendered into the ConfigMap (values are quoted). For upstream variables the chart does not model, such as `FILAMENT_AVATAR_PROVIDER: gravatar`. Never put secrets here.

extraEnvVars.description: Extra `env:` entries appended verbatim to the Panel container (valueFrom supported), rendered through `tpl`.

extraEnvFrom.description: Extra `envFrom:` sources appended to the Panel container, rendered through `tpl`.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret holding APP_KEY (and optionally the mail password). Takes precedence over appKey and the generated key. Required for GitOps: `helm template` cannot read the cluster, so a generated key changes on every render and invalidates every encrypted value and session.

existingSecretMailPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding MAIL_PASSWORD. Empty sets no mail password from it.

appKey.description: Explicit APP_KEY, `base64:` followed by 32 random bytes in base64 (`php artisan key:generate --show`, or `echo base64:$(openssl rand -base64 32)`). Stored in the chart-managed Secret. Empty reuses the key already in that Secret, else generates one.

database.description: External database. Ignored while mariadb.enabled is true, which points the Panel at the bundled MariaDB.

connection.description: `DB_CONNECTION`. sqlite stores the database in the /pelican-data volume and ignores every other key of this block except name.

host.description: `DB_HOST`. Required for pgsql, mysql and mariadb unless existingSecretHostKey is set.

port.description: `DB_PORT`. Empty uses 5432 for pgsql and 3306 for mysql and mariadb.

name.description: `DB_DATABASE`. For sqlite a path, or a file name under the Panel's database/ directory.

password.description: `DB_PASSWORD` in clear text, stored in the chart-managed Secret. Prefer existingSecret.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret with the database credentials, such as the `<cluster>-app` Secret CloudNativePG generates.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the password.

existingSecretUsernameKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the user name. Empty uses `username`.

existingSecretDatabaseKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the database name. Empty uses `name`.

existingSecretHostKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the host. Empty uses `host`.

existingSecretPortKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the port. Empty uses `port`.

mariadb.description: Bundled single-replica MariaDB StatefulSet for quick starts. Not intended for production; use an external database or CloudNativePG there.

enabled.description: Deploy MariaDB and point the Panel at it, overriding database.connection, host and port.

database.description: Database created on first start, also used as DB_DATABASE.

username.description: Application user, also used as DB_USERNAME.

password.description: Application user password. Empty generates one on first install and keeps it (not stable under `helm template`; see panel.existingSecret).

rootPassword.description: Root password. Empty generates one the same way.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret with the MariaDB passwords. Replaces password and rootPassword.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in auth.existingSecret holding the application user password.

existingSecretRootPasswordKey.description: Key in auth.existingSecret holding the root password.

enabled.description: Use a PVC. With false the data lives in an emptyDir and is lost with the pod.

storageClass.description: StorageClass. Empty uses the cluster default.

resources.description: Resources of the MariaDB container. Empty sets none.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext of MariaDB. Empty suits OpenShift, where the SCC assigns IDs; set fsGroup and runAsUser on other clusters when the volume is not writable.

redis.description: Bundled single-replica Redis Deployment as cache, session or queue backend. Set panel.cacheStore, sessionDriver or queueConnection to redis to use it.

enabled.description: Deploy Redis and point the Panel at it.

password.description: `REDIS_PASSWORD`, stored in the chart-managed Secret. Empty runs Redis without auth, reachable only through its cluster-internal Service.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret holding the Redis password. Replaces password.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the password.

resources.description: Resources of the Redis container. Empty sets none.

externalRedis.description: External Redis, used when a redis driver is selected and redis.enabled is false.

username.description: `REDIS_USERNAME` (Redis 6 ACL user). Empty leaves it unset.

password.description: `REDIS_PASSWORD`, stored in the chart-managed Secret. Prefer existingSecret.

existingSecret.description: Pre-created Secret holding the Redis password. Replaces password.

existingSecretPasswordKey.description: Key in existingSecret holding the password.

persistence.description: Volume for /pelican-data: the .env, the sqlite database, avatars, icons, fonts and plugins.

enabled.description: Use a PVC. With false /pelican-data is an emptyDir, and the Panel loses its .env (and a key generated by the image) on every restart.

existingClaim.description: Use this existing PVC instead of creating one.

storageClass.description: StorageClass. Empty uses the cluster default; `-` sets an empty storageClassName (no dynamic provisioning).

accessMode.description: PVC access mode. ReadWriteOnce fits one replica (with strategy Recreate).

retain.description: Keep the PVC when the release is uninstalled (`helm.sh/resource-policy: keep`).

port.description: Service port. It targets HTTP on 80, or FastCGI on 9000 with panel.skipCaddy.

nodePort.description: Fixed nodePort, used only with type NodePort. Empty lets Kubernetes pick one. Must be inside the cluster's service-node-port-range (30000-32767 by default).

ingress.description: Ingress for the Panel. Set panel.behindProxy and panel.trustedProxies with it.

className.description: ingressClassName. Empty uses the cluster's default class.

annotations.description: Ingress annotations (cert-manager issuer, body size, timeouts).

hosts.description: Ingress rules. host is rendered through `tpl`. Every path routes to the Panel Service.

host.description: Hostname of the rule; should match panel.url.

pathType.description: How path matches. Unset uses Prefix.

secretName.description: kubernetes.io/tls Secret holding the certificate. Empty lets the controller use its default certificate.

route.description: OpenShift Route for the Panel. Needs the route.openshift.io API.

host.description: Route host, rendered through `tpl`. Empty lets the router generate `<name>-<namespace>.<apps domain>`.

path.description: Route path. Empty routes every path.

termination.description: edge terminates at the router (the Panel serves plain HTTP behind it), passthrough sends TLS to the pod, reencrypt opens a new TLS connection to the pod.

insecureEdgeTerminationPolicy.description: What plain HTTP requests get: Redirect to HTTPS, Allow, or None (rejected). Empty leaves it unset.

scc.description: SCC grant for the Panel. The image runs as the fixed non-root user www-data (UID 82), which the default restricted-v2 SCC rejects.

enabled.description: Create a RoleBinding granting use of the SCC.

name.description: SCC to grant. nonroot-v2 is the least privilege that allows a fixed non-root UID; anyuid also works.

bindToNamespaceGroup.description: Bind to the group `system:serviceaccounts:<namespace>`, covering every ServiceAccount in the namespace (and so MariaDB and Redis), instead of the Panel's ServiceAccount only.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod securityContext of the Panel. The defaults run as www-data (82) and add the safe sysctl `net.ipv4.ip_unprivileged_port_start=0`, without which Caddy cannot bind :80 as non-root (NET_BIND_SERVICE cannot help: Kubernetes grants no ambient capabilities). On clusters that assign UIDs, set {} and either keep the sysctl or set panel.skipCaddy.

securityContext.description: Container securityContext of the Panel. readOnlyRootFilesystem stays false: the image writes caches under /var/www/html/storage.

resources.description: Resources of the Panel container. The memory and ephemeral-storage limits keep a runaway Panel from taking the node down; raise them for a large installation.

probes.description: Probes of the Panel container, all HTTP GET /up. Disabled entirely with panel.skipCaddy.

startup.description: Startup probe, covering the entrypoint's migrate and optimize phase before Caddy listens. The defaults allow about 10 minutes.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Failed probes before the container is restarted.

readiness.description: Readiness probe: takes the pod out of the Service while it fails.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Failed probes before the pod is marked unready.

liveness.description: Liveness probe: restarts the container while it fails.

timeoutSeconds.description: Seconds before a probe times out.

failureThreshold.description: Failed probes before the container is restarted.

strategy.description: Deployment strategy. Recreate is required with a ReadWriteOnce volume, which a second pod cannot mount.

type.description: Recreate stops the old pod before starting the new one; RollingUpdate overlaps them.

rollingUpdate.description: RollingUpdate parameters. Only valid with type RollingUpdate.

maxSurge.description: Extra pods allowed during the update, as a number or percentage.

maxUnavailable.description: Pods allowed to be unavailable during the update, as a number or percentage.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Seconds the Panel gets to stop. The upstream queue worker allows jobs up to 3600 s; 120 is a middle ground.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector of the Panel pod.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints of the Panel pod.

priorityClassName.description: PriorityClass of the Panel pod. Empty uses the cluster default.

extraVolumes.description: Extra volumes of the Panel pod, rendered through `tpl`.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Extra volume mounts of the Panel container, rendered through `tpl`.

name.description: Name of the volume to mount.

initContainers.description: Extra init containers of the Panel pod, as Container specs, rendered through `tpl`.

dnsLabel.description: An RFC 1123 label: lower-case alphanumerics and '-', starting and ending alphanumeric, at most 63 characters.

dnsSubdomain.description: An RFC 1123 subdomain: lower-case alphanumerics, '-' and '.', at most 253 characters (names of most Kubernetes objects).

dnsSubdomainOrEmpty.description: An RFC 1123 subdomain, or empty for unset.

secretKey.description: A Secret data key: alphanumerics, '-', '_' and '.'.

secretKeyOrEmpty.description: A Secret data key, or empty for unset.

envVarName.description: An environment variable name. Kubernetes accepts any printable ASCII except '='; Laravel reads upper-case names.

emailOrEmpty.description: An email address, or empty for unset.

stringMap.description: A map of string keys to string values (annotations, node selectors). Quote values YAML would read as numbers or booleans.

labelMap.description: Kubernetes labels: values of at most 63 characters, alphanumerics, '-', '_' and '.', starting and ending alphanumeric, or empty.

optionalPort.description: A port number, as an integer or a numeric string, or empty for unset.

intOrPercent.description: An integer, or a percentage string such as `25%`.

simpleImage.description: An image as repository, tag and pull policy.

quantity.description: A Kubernetes resource quantity: a number with an optional suffix (`100m`, `0.5`, `1`, `512Mi`, `2Gi`, `1e3`).

storageSize.description: A PVC size as a Kubernetes quantity string (`5Gi`, `500Mi`).

storageClass.description: A StorageClass name, empty for the cluster default, or `-` for an empty storageClassName.

resourceList.description: A map of resource names (cpu, memory, ephemeral-storage, hugepages-<size>, extended resources) to quantities.

resourceRequirements.description: Container resources (`requests`, `limits`, `claims`), rendered verbatim into the container spec.

requests.description: Resources the scheduler reserves for the container.

limits.description: Upper bounds the kubelet enforces. A CPU limit throttles, a memory limit OOM-kills.

claims.description: Dynamic resource claims of the pod used by this container.

seccompProfile.description: A seccomp profile. Localhost needs localhostProfile.

appArmorProfile.description: An AppArmor profile. Localhost needs localhostProfile.

windowsOptions.description: Windows-specific settings; ignored on Linux nodes.

podSecurityContext.$comment: Field list of PodSecurityContext as of Kubernetes 1.35.

runAsGroup.description: Primary GID of every container's entrypoint.

runAsNonRoot.description: Refuse to start containers that would run as UID 0.

fsGroup.description: Supplementary GID owning mounted volumes, which makes them writable for the pod.

fsGroupChangePolicy.description: When volume ownership is changed to fsGroup.

supplementalGroups.description: Extra GIDs of the first process of every container.

supplementalGroupsPolicy.description: Whether the image's /etc/group memberships are merged in.

seLinuxChangePolicy.description: How SELinux labels are applied to volumes.

sysctls.description: Namespaced sysctls set for the pod. Unsafe sysctls must be allowed on the kubelet.

securityContext.description: A Kubernetes container SecurityContext, rendered verbatim.
securityContext.$comment: Field list of SecurityContext as of Kubernetes 1.35.

allowPrivilegeEscalation.description: Allow a process to gain more privileges than its parent (setuid, file capabilities).

privileged.description: Run as privileged, equivalent to root on the host.

readOnlyRootFilesystem.description: Mount the container's root filesystem read-only.

runAsNonRoot.description: Refuse to start when the container would run as UID 0.

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities to add and drop.

key.description: Taint key. Empty with operator Exists matches every taint.

operator.description: Exists matches any value, Equal the given value. Lt and Gt compare numerically and need the TaintTolerationComparisonOperators feature gate.

value.description: Taint value. Leave empty with operator Exists.

effect.description: Taint effect to match. Empty matches every effect.

tolerationSeconds.description: With effect NoExecute, how long the pod stays bound after the taint appears. Unset tolerates forever.

affinity.description: A Kubernetes Affinity, rendered verbatim. The three rule kinds are passed through unchecked.

podAffinity.description: Rules attracting the pod to nodes running matching pods.

podAntiAffinity.description: Rules keeping the pod away from nodes running matching pods.

maxSkew.description: Largest allowed difference in matching pods between topology domains.

topologyKey.description: Node label defining the domains, such as topology.kubernetes.io/zone.

whenUnsatisfiable.description: DoNotSchedule keeps the pod Pending, ScheduleAnyway only prefers.

labelSelector.description: Selects the pods counted. Usually the Panel's own labels.

matchLabelKeys.description: Pod label keys whose values are added to labelSelector.

minDomains.description: Minimum number of eligible domains (DoNotSchedule only).

nodeAffinityPolicy.description: Whether nodeAffinity and nodeSelector limit the domains.

nodeTaintsPolicy.description: Whether node taints limit the domains.

envVar.description: A Kubernetes EnvVar: a name with either a value or a valueFrom source.

value.description: Literal value. Always a string; quote numbers and booleans.

envFromSource.description: A Kubernetes EnvFromSource: every key of a ConfigMap or Secret as environment variables.

prefix.description: Prefix added to every variable name.
